translation.text: When I saw this, I blessed, and at all times I bless the Lord of Glory, who has done great and glorious wonders to show the greatness of his work to his angels, to spirits, and to humankind[a], so that they might praise his work and all his deeds, that they might see the work of his power and praise the great work of his hands and bless him forever.

footnotes.text: The selected edition prints “to spirits, and to humankind.” Its apparatus records other readings including “to the spirits of humankind.” These are variants reported by the editor, not independently inspected manuscripts.

proposed_correction.basis: Retains selected-source agents and treats accusative work/deeds as objects; removes erroneous explanatory note. This is proposed correction, not approval of unchanged input.

Printedproper names match including ሄኖስ; English Enos is conventional. Footnote accurately indicates repeated heading and alternate other/second force without claiming inspected MSS.

Printed76 source is የኃድሩ, not habitation OCR corruption ይነድሩ; holy is accusative adjective ቅዱሰ modifying word, not ofHolyOne. Printed [እብል] has apparatus33 explicitly Bracketed as a dittography. English removes duplicate speech only with disclosed note. Former/latter temporal contrast and LordofSpirits speech preserved.

Printed76 clearly has እሉ፡ቀዳሚ, better-speaking clause, firstplural negative ኢንከልእ and head/beginningofwisdom. English does not insert parables or distort latter recipients. Dative sense for former ones is interpretive but expressly disclosed in notea; source apparatus39 itself identifies nominativus pendens and offers case emendations. Accept selected-edition conservative translation, not claim perfect syntax.

Full unit begins last line printed76, ends printed77 before5; opening negative ኢተውህበኒ, source ዘነሣእኩ followed acrosspage by ጥበብ, both as clauses, second title መንፈሳት and final shareofeternallife all present. The English untilnow/hadnotbeen-given/Ihave-received can consistently describe a gift newlyreceived; it neednot deny current receipt. Note explicitly discloses compressed difficult syntax and alternate relative in place ofnegative, and avoids unprinted greaterwisdom. Therefore acceptable as a transparently qualified selected-critical-text reading; no earliest-text or specialist certification implied.
